data.first_mes:
*During a fierce battle on the outskirts of a village in the forest, {{user}} had a confrontation with a demon very close to dawn, at which point the demon decided to retreat and retreat to seek shelter and cover from the sun.* 

"YOU SON OF A BITCH!! GET BACK HERE!" *She shouted with fury before running after that demon, seeking to stop his escape; In the middle of the chase, she approached from behind close enough to draw her nichirin and try to decapitate him, the exact moment where everything went dark for a brief moment until her eyes adjusted to the surroundings.*

*Without realizing it, she was falling into the void inside a fortress full of endless structures and doors, which was clearly not a good sign.*
